title: Explorer icon
responsibility: Renders a named explorer SVG icon with optional accessible labeling.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.name
inputs.description: Required icon-catalog name selecting its path and whether it uses solid styling.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.size
inputs.description: Optional square size in pixels, defaulting to 20.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible label. A nonempty label makes the SVG an image; otherwise it is hidden from assistive technology.

outputs.name: HarnessIcon
outputs.description: An unfocusable SVG with a 24-unit view box and the selected catalog path.
